about.title: About Us
about.description: Because healthcare services in Kabul are often provided individually — not as a team — and without shared consultation among specialists, patient satisfaction suffers. Moaser Specialized Dental Hospital was established to change this. We operate as a fully equipped complex with modern facilities, specialist collaboration, and a commitment to evidence-based dentistry close to international standards.
about.feature1Desc: Collaborative approach with specialists across all dental disciplines.
about.feature2Desc: Equipped with cutting-edge digital dental technology and facilities.
about.feature3Desc: Scientific, evidence-based treatment protocols close to international standards.
about.feature4Desc: Trained, specialized personnel with advanced qualifications.
about.feature5Desc: Expert root canal therapy and comprehensive restorative dental treatments.
about.feature6Desc: Traditional braces and wire-free clear aligner orthodontics for dental correction.
about.feature7Desc: Zirconia covers, E.max laminates, PFM & PFZ crowns, and various prosthetic solutions.
about.quote: "Our team strives to achieve success rates as close as possible to modern standards. While 100% success is not guaranteed in dental treatment, we maximize every effort for your satisfaction."

vision.title: Vision, Mission, Objectives & Values
vision.visionText: Contemporary Dental Hospital aims to become a reputable and leading center in providing standard dental services nationwide. Relying on up-to-date knowledge, developing specialized capacities, and improving the quality of services, this hospital strives to play a prominent role in improving the oral, dental, jaw, and facial health of the community and to be recognized as a model and center of medical tourism in the field of dentistry.
vision.missionText: As a leading, reputable and authoritative institution in the field of dentistry and stomatology in Afghanistan, Modern Dental Hospital is committed to providing accurate, standard and evidence-based services to the community, relying on modern knowledge, advanced technology and expert staff, and taking solid steps to improve the health of the community by focusing on diagnosis, treatment and prevention. With absolute adherence to the principles of medical ethics and respect for clients, we determine our fundamental mission to meet the medical needs of patients, establish the high position of the stomatology sector and become a leading and authoritative hospital in Afghanistan.
vision.goalsText: Since the provision of health services in Kabul is done individually and non-teamwise, without the participation of a group of specialists, relying on individual opinions and without consulting a group of highly trained specialists, at the same time with the lack of facilities or few facilities or the lack of modern and advanced technology, and in a poor quality. Ultimately, it does not satisfy the compatriots and does not achieve the desired and satisfactory result for the compatriots. Therefore, we intend to establish a specialist team with the participation of multiple departments of the dental field, a complex equipped with advanced facilities and technology, and try to provide effective, useful and satisfactory services to our compatriots.
vision.valuesIntro: Contemporary Dental Hospital adheres to these values and strives to implement them as much as possible:
vision.value1: Commitment to the religion of Islam, centered on ethics and preserving human dignity
vision.value2: Accurate, honest services, based on scientific knowledge and evidence, and specialization
vision.value4: Scientific and academic research and the production of medical science and knowledge
